text:
Iris: Short thread to lock GA "final cut" items. Need owners for: SLA language, customer docs quickstart, support rota, monitoring/alerts, pricing table. Also confirm scope cuts.

Cal: I'll take monitoring + alert playbooks. Minimum: per-route p95, 5xx%, token-rate, cache_hit. Add a deploy-time synthetic that verifies streaming integrity. Alerts: p95 > 350ms for 5m, 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

Jordan: I can do SLA + runbook. Proposal: Standard 99.5% (email), Business 99.8% (4h P1), Enterprise 99.95% (2h P1 + AM). Runbook will include immediate fallback to smaller model variant and a step-by-step rollback. Need legal OK on credit language.

Priya: Docs owner. Deliverables: quickstart (JS + Python), streaming reconnect sample, error table + retry guidance, and a short "what's not in GA" section for alpha features. I'll add a migration checklist for dedicated customers.

Iris: Scope call: drop custom quantization flows and experimental latency-aware autoscale from GA. Mark both alpha in docs and include migration notes. Agreed?

Cal: Agreed. I'll include a dashboard panel showing cache_hit and token_cost, and a sample alerting dashboard JSON in the PR.

Jordan: For support ops: recommend 24/5 warm coverage for first 14 days with one dedicated responder weekdays, plus oncall-escalation to Eng-SRE and ModelOps. I'll draft escalation matrix.

Priya: Pricing: keep GA simple 1 flat per-token + embeddings unit. Offer an "early enterprise" coupon for pilots; no tiering at GA. Need FinOps sign-off on projected revenue impact.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled tomorrow 03:45 UTC. Please run streaming smoke, token-cost validation, and the quickstart end-to-end test.

Iris: Let's add a pre-merge checklist for launch PRs: 1) linked SLA doc, 2) runbook + escalation matrix, 3) docs quickstart + migration notes, 4) monitoring dashboard + alert rules, 5) pricing draft + FinOps ack. All five must be linked and reviewed 12h before canary.

Cal: I'll produce the alert playbook and attach perf thresholds. Also will add a short runbook snippet: if p95 > 400ms for 3 checks, flip route to smaller-model and page oncall.

Jordan: I'll circulate SLA wording for legal/commercial review by EOD. Also will add the 14-day warm rota schedule.

Priya: Drafting the docs PR now; will include code samples and a small "known limitations" callout for alpha features.

Iris: Good. Final ask: every owner drop a one-line status update by 18:00 PT today so I can assemble the owners email.

Priya: Noted 1 will post status by 17:30.

Cal: Will upload dashboard JSON and alert rules before EOD.

Jordan: Will share SLA draft shortly.

Iris: Thanks 1 if all checklist links are green we proceed with the canary.
